integrity: The Fourier integral, renewal identity, and integral-comparison proof establish the universal statements. A finite checker offers independent implementation cross-checks, not a replacement for proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to symmetric nearest-neighbor translation-invariant walks on the cubic lattice, with positive coordinate weights. Originality priority remains subject to older exact Green-function analyses that were not available in complete form; no independent audit is claimed.
title: A sharp uniform escape boundary layer for fully anisotropic cubic walks
